messages.subject: TVAR.sim
messages.body_plain:
Dear developers,

Thank you very much for the very helpful package and your tremendous effort!

I have question about the TVAR.sim  and VAR.sim functions; I want to use different variance-covariance structures for different innovations in the VAR structure within varcov arguments, but I think it is not appropriate way of using the varcov argument as in this case. I want to modify VAR.sim and TVAR.sim but it returns TVAR.gen function which is unavailable. Could you make it available? or you may suggest a proper way to do it.

Thank you in advance,

Best regards,

Sipan

messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] TVAR.sim
messages.body_plain:
Hi Siplan

I am not sure about what you want to do exactly, but yes, the actual code does not allow to introduce correlation in the errrors. So if you want to have a look at the code, indeed, TVAR.gen is not "exported to the user" and hence not directly available, so you can either:
-download the source code: http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/tsDyn_0.9-32.tar.gz
-type tsDyn:::TVAR.gen

Hope this helps

Matthieu

2013/11/4 Sipan Aslan <aslan...@gmail.com>

messages.subject: Prediction command in the TVECMseo 2002
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

  I am writing codes to analyse some variables. I have analyzed the performance of the linear cointegration model and the performance is really poor out-of-sample. So i decide to go further with non linear TVECM cointegration models with Seo(2002). Howvever i need to evaluate the out-of-sample performance of the Seo TVECM(2002) for bivariate models. Please can someone tell me how to code this. I have used the following codes:

library(tsDyn)
TVECM.HStest(KtH1, lag=1, ngridTh=300, trim=0.05,
nboot=100, fixed.beta=NULL, intercept=TRUE,
boot.type=c("FixedReg", "ResBoot"),
hpc=c("none", "foreach"))
tv1<-TVECM(KtH1, nthresh=1,lag=1, ngridBeta=20, ngridTh=30, plot=TRUE,trim=0.05, common="All")
print(tv1)
summary(tv1)
predict(tv1)
 But R is telling me this  "Error in min(y) : invalid 'type' (list) of argument". Please can someone help me to code this. It is very well explained the package Pfaff for VAR and VECM models

  Regards

messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] Prediction command in the TVECMseo 2002
messages.body_plain:
Hi

Unfortunately, the predict() function has not been implemented for TVECM models, which is why you get this error message. If you want to implement it, look at the code from TVECM.sim, which will be very helpul.

Best

Matthieu

2013/11/17 ntamj...@yahoo.fr <ngue...@yahoo.fr>
